capability_probe.implementation: journeys/helpers.ts p18bMountState(): filesystem + source inspection — apps/web/app/live-mission/page.tsx exists OR apps/web/app/mission/page.tsx renders LiveMissionPage (MOUNTING.md step 1), AND apps/web/app/api/live-mission/actions/route.ts exists (MOUNTING.md step 2)
capability_probe.gate_semantics: describe.skipIf(!mounted) on every route-level suite; the always-run probe test prints the explicit gate state line '[P18-C route-level specs] ... => SKIPPED (requires-p18b-mount)' and asserts the loader records agree with the filesystem probe
capability_probe.lazy_loading: import.meta.glob registers ONLY existing files, so absent mounts never break collection; when present, the route modules load through the Vite transform (server components are awaited before static rendering)

integration_contract.for_p18b: mount exactly what MOUNTING.md documents: (1) apps/web/app/live-mission/page.tsx rendering LiveMissionPage (the data plane wired per MOUNTING.md step 3 or the honest emptyLiveObservation), optionally pointing apps/web/app/mission/page.tsx at LiveMissionPage; (2) the POST handler at apps/web/app/api/live-mission/actions that validates + executes the form-encoded `action` envelope (the same ActionRequest JSON the forms post) through the merged ActionGateway and returns the serialized gateway outcome (receipt with status + evidenceIds, or the typed rejection) — never a silent 5xx
integration_contract.for_the_architect: after A -> B -> C integration, run `pnpm --filter @sos-2/tests-live-ux test` on the integrated head: ALL 125 tests must be enabled and green (0 skipped) before P18 can complete; a red or still-skipped suite is an honest integration finding, never fabricatable
integration_contract.never_fabricated: the route-level suites assert nothing about the mounts while absent; their pass states exist only when the mounts exist and behave per the documented contract
